reviewContext.issueReference: none (workflow opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-959; intake comm-024231; design accepted comm-024233; plans comm-024234; plan review accepted comm-024235)
reviewContext.userProblem: The Lean 4 formal verification of nodetto is almost finished: 40 of 42 plans are accepted, but reorderCommands_spec (design section 6.2) is still unproved after twelve continuations, and docs/formal.md, the umbrella module formal/Nodetto.lean and the mise prove task do not exist yet, so mise run prove cannot pass. The user wants the theorem proved exactly as stated (in small one-sitting plans following the design 6.2.1 proof architecture) and the documentation written, so that mise run prove passes on the whole project.
requiredOutcomes: reorderCommands_refuses, reorderCommands_unchanged and reorderCommands_spec exist in formal/Nodetto/ZOrder/Reorder.lean with exactly the design section 6.2 signatures and the ZOrder audit passes with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
mise run prove exits 0 for the whole project (all modules build, no forbidden tokens, 66 required statements checked, open statements listed, vectors fresh).
docs/formal.md documents how to run, the statement table with statuses, B1-B8, D1-D7, the Open list, what is not proved and the two known conformance limitations; README.md mentions it.
bun run typecheck, bun run lint and the *.formal.test.ts conformance tests pass at integration.
nonGoals: No redesign, re-plan or re-implementation of the 40 accepted plans; their files are not edited.
No change to theorem statements in design section 6, to formal/Nodetto/ZOrder/Model.lean, to vectors or to packages/.
No Reorder/*.lean submodules; formal/Nodetto/ZOrder.lean and formal/scripts/audit.ts are unchanged.
The open statements decodeNmesh_encodeNmesh, treeSearch_visits_overlaps and overlappingPairs_visits_overlaps are not attempted.
The mergeById Map comparison and thin NMESH edge-case vectors are recorded as limitations, not fixed.
prove is not added to verify, test, ci or any CI workflow. No push, worktree, branch or history change; no server, auth, secret or deployment code.
constraints: fv-24a to fv-24f all edit formal/Nodetto/ZOrder/Reorder.lean and run strictly in sequence (dependsOn chain); fv-50-docs runs after fv-24f.

Lean runs only as `cd formal && mise exec -- lake build Nodetto.ZOrder` (fv-24 plans) or through formal/scripts/audit and mise run prove (fv-50). Never lake clean; retry a build-lock failure up to three times and log it.

Proof integrity: no sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide, unsafe, partial, opaque, implemented_by, extern, skipKernelTC or #exit anywhere in formal/**/*.lean (comments included), no maxHeartbeats option.

Private helpers from design 6.2.1 may be strengthened or have their loop argument list adapted (recorded in the progress file); the three section 6.2 theorems are copied verbatim and never weakened. A false statement stops the plan with a Lean counterexample plus TypeScript input (needs_design_revision).
Workers read fresh before each edit and record git hash-object before and after in impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md; no git state changes.
Per-plan gates never include bun run typecheck, bun run lint or mise run verify; those run once at integration. At most two bun test processes at a time.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD1: refuses and unchanged already match section 6.2 verbatim; only reorderCommands_spec remains.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reorder.lean lines 403-419 equal design lines 330-336; the prior audit reports only allowed axioms for both.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD2: no counterexample expected; the proof follows design 6.2.1 (scan, LoopInv, between_bounds, renumber fallback, untouched_element).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Hand proof in the design; the step 3 review found no gap.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD3: all lemmas stay in Reorder.lean; no submodules.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Avoids import-list and audit changes that risk the whole-project prove.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD4/FD5: a named scanStep and four loop equation lemmas isolate do-notation unfolding; loop_ok is generic over P.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Makes each sitting small and independent of elaboration details.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD6: the actual reorderCommands.loop signature is recorded by fv-24b and used by fv-24e/fv-24f.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The design sandbox could not run Lean, so the captured-argument order was not observed.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD7: the two low conformance findings are documented as known limitations.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: They concern only the evidence of accepted plans, and fixing them could expose model differences outside this run's scope.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: FD8: fv-50-docs creates formal/Nodetto.lean and the mise prove task and depends only on fv-24f.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Both are missing and required by full-mode prove; other plans are accepted.

intentionalTradeoffs: Serial seven-plan chain (FD3): every fv-24 plan edits formal/Nodetto/ZOrder/Reorder.lean, so there is no parallelism; longer wall-clock time is accepted in exchange for no edit conflicts.
Private helper lemmas may be adapted with a recorded note when do-notation elaboration differs (FD6); the section 6.2 statements stay verbatim.
The mergeById Map comparison and the thin NMESH edge-case vectors are documented as known limitations in docs/formal.md instead of being fixed (FD7).
supportedEdgeCases: reorderCommands guard false (refuses) and no-change (unchanged) paths.
Loop paths: empty list, kept element, keyBetween/keyAfter failure falling back to renumber, moved element bounded by between_bounds.
Untouched elements keep their keys (untouched_element frame lemma).
Shared formal/.lake build lock: retry up to three times, never lake clean.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: decodeNmesh_encodeNmesh, treeSearch_visits_overlaps and overlappingPairs_visits_overlaps stay allowed-open.
Floating-point inputs outside the integer bridging assumption stated in the design.
Running prove in verify or CI (linux.yml has no verify job).
